verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The official MCP server lets external AI assistants access Bitwarden, and the CLI and APIs are programmatic building blocks; both belong to separate stories and do not count as a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
